verdict.rationale: Adyen for Platforms explicitly documents onboarding sellers with verification (adyen-docs-11, adyen-docs-31, adyen-docs-36), splitting payments between parties and deducting costs (adyen-docs-21, adyen-docs-37), and configurable payouts including frequency, currency, and local/cross-border options (adyen-docs-9, adyen-docs-12, adyen-docs-13, adyen-docs-22, adyen-docs-30, adyen-docs-43) — covering the full onboard/split/payout marketplace flow described in the story. missing for 10: independent/hands-on developer corroboration specifically of the Platforms product (community evidence is about general Adyen integration, not marketplace/split-payment flows), and no code samples or API reference snippets showing the split/payout request structure in this pack.
